sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Ebhla is an Irish heroine. She was the daughter of Cathbad, the evil druid, and his wife Maga. Through him she was the granddaughter of Aonghus Óg, the god of poetry. Ebhla raised the fated Sons of Uisneach.

okr.objective: Give the genealogy of the Irish heroine Ebhla.
key_results: Ebhla was the daughter of the druid Cathbad and his wife Maga.
Through them she was the granddaughter of the god Aonghus Óg.
Her children were the fated Sons of Uisneach.
